prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one objectively “best” personal‑injury lawyer for every Houston car wreck — the best lawyer for you depends on your injuries, fault issues, desired outcome (quick settlement vs taking it to trial), and personal preferences. I can help you find the right match.

How to pick the best Houston car‑wreck lawyer for your case
- Look for relevant experience: substantial car‑crash and personal‑injury work (not primarily criminal or family law). Ask how many car wreck cases they handle per year and how many went to trial.
- Trial experience and verdicts: a lawyer who will actually take a case to trial if necessary usually gets better settlement offers.
- Track record in similar cases: prior settlements/verdicts for cases with similar injuries and liability facts.
- Reputation and peer recognition: Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell ratings, Texas Trial Lawyers Association involvement, client reviews.
- Communication and accessibility: clear point of contact, regular updates, who handles day‑to‑day work (attorney vs paralegal).
- Fee structure and costs: most work on contingency (commonly ~33%–40% plus case expenses). Get fee terms in writing.
- Medical lien and billing handling: will they help get medical care and manage liens?
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Houston courts, judges, local experts, and hospitals/medical providers.

Practical steps to find and vet lawyers
1. Use referrals and directories: Texas State Bar Lawyer Referral, Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, AVVO reviews, and local bar associations.
2. Interview at least 3 lawyers—use the checklist below.
3. Verify credentials: Texas State Bar search for current license and disciplinary history.
4. Ask for examples of results in cases like yours and contact references if offered.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How long have you handled auto‑crash PI cases in Houston?
- What percentage of your practice is car wreck/personal injury?
- How many cases like mine have you handled, and what were the results?
- Will you be my main attorney or will others in the firm handle it?
- Do you try cases? What is your trial win rate?
- How do you charge (contingency %, costs) and when do I owe expenses?
- How will you handle medical bills and liens?
- What is your estimate of the case value and timeline?
- What do you need from me now?

Important legal note
- Texas generally has a two‑year statute of limitations for personal injury (2 years from the date of the wreck). Don’t wait to talk to a lawyer.

If you want, I can:
- Prepare a short list of well‑rated Houston personal‑injury attorneys (I’ll need your ZIP code or neighborhood and a few case facts), or
- Draft an email/text you can send to attorneys requesting a free consult, or
- Give a short script for what to say on initial calls.

Which would you like me to do? If you want attorney names, tell me your ZIP code and a couple of details about the crash (date, severity of injuries, whether fault is contested).
